milestoneDescription: Complete the proposal Google Doc: working RQ, rationale, methods, and 3 starter sources.

milestoneTitle: EE handbook quiz & academic integrity agreement
milestoneDescription: Pass the short academic-integrity quiz, then upload your signed agreement. Both are required.
Supervisor reviews the proposal and approves it or returns it with changes.
Coordinator matches each student with a subject-appropriate supervisor.
First of three required supervisory sessions. Supervisor logs date and summary.
Submit your outline Doc: argument structure, section summaries, evidence map.
Submit your research plan Doc with at least 6 annotated sources.
Mid-process supervisory session — review research progress and outline.
Submit your draft Doc (max 4,000 words). Supervisor comments once; draft goes through Turnitin.
Supervisor checks edit history + Turnitin, then returns comments on the single permitted full draft.
Polish the SAME Doc, run the final-submission checklist; a PDF is filed as the version of record.
Concluding supervisory session (viva voce) — logged by the supervisor.
Write your ONE official reflective statement (max 500 words) on the RPF, after the viva.
Supervisor report and comment for the IB submission.
Choose whether your essay stays in the school archive as an exemplar — name never shared, only the writing.
